messages:
ana: Heads-up for Friday KPI review 1: our launch-posts drove traffic but routed leads are down vs dashboard. can we quick triage?

michael: Which tile? weekly_kpis -> routed_leads?

ana: yep, filter=launch-spring; Looker shows 1,290 regs, CRM shows 980.

metrics-bot: ETL refresh complete at 07:05 UTC; looker.weekly_kpis refreshed; total_registrations: 1,290

ryan: quick check: GA events show 1,312 webinar_reg, Looker 1,290, CRM 980. early sign: ~240 rows missing campaign attribution (utm null) and ~70 rejected by CRM validation.

michael: likely causes: landing script sometimes strips long utm_campaigns, and a recent CRM validation change rejects null_company_size for new campaigns.

ana: action items: (1) ryan run a cohort count and add a "ingestion variance" card to KPI board, (2) michael schedule a partial backfill for rejected leads and post job id, (3) ping ad-ops for CPA delta if those 240 map to paid.

ryan: added card + counts: utm_present=1,050, utm_missing=240, crm_rejected=70.

michael: backfill queued bf-176912-01; ETA 30m. will post results.

ad-ops: FYI if 240 are reassigned to paid, estimated paid CPA +11% last week. will join Friday 9:30 to explain.

metrics-bot: KPI card "ingestion variance" created by ryan at 10:14

ana: thanks team. we'll show the numbers and the remediation plan (landing script fix, move gclid decode earlier, relax non-critical validation for ingestion) in Friday slides. concise and transparent.
